the number of boys.

We have:
- $G + B = 35$
- $G$ is a multiple of 13
- $G > B$

The multiples of 13 that are at most 35 are 13 and 26.

If $G = 13$, then $B = 22$, but we need $G > B$, so this doesn't work.

If $G = 26$, then $B = 35 - 26 = 9$, and $26 > 9$ works.

So there are 9 boys.
